name: TruncatedText
description:
One line of text that ends in an ellipsis when it does not fit, and shows the full text
in a tooltip only when it was actually cut (R8.1). Truncated standalone text becomes
keyboard focusable; text inside a focusable control adds no nested tab stop. It lays out as a block that fills its
box, so the parent decides the width; flex parents need `min-width: 0` on the slot.
signature: ({ children, text, middle, numeric, tooltipSide, className, ...rest }: TruncatedTextProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: middle
props.description:
Truncate in the middle so both ends stay visible (hostnames, serials, paths):
`true` cuts before the last segment, a number keeps that many trailing characters.

props.name: numeric
props.description: Tabular figures for identifiers and numbers (implied by `middle`).

props.name: text
props.description: Full accessible tooltip text for rich nodes. Defaults to the rendered textContent.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
